```
g:\1.1-PROJECT-MAIN\khảo sát - nsg\hos\Controls\Poll\
```

### Legacy TeacherPoll (SIM-based, not `POL_*`)

- `g:\1.1-PROJECT-MAIN\khảo sát - nsg\hos\Pages\TeacherPoll\Default.aspx`
- `g:\1.1-PROJECT-MAIN\khảo sát - nsg\hos\Pages\TeacherPoll\PollSummary.aspx`
- Uses `SIM_PollAnswer_Summary`, not `PollObject`

### Page routing patterns

| Route | Params | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `/khaosat.aspx` | `pid` (encoded PlanID) | Primary poll URL |
| `/khaosat.aspx` | `pid` + `cid` (encoded CompanyID) | Company-specific poll |
| `/khaosat.aspx` | `key` = encoded `"PlanID\|CompanyID"` | Combined key |
| `/khaosat.aspx` | `company` = company code | Lookup via `GEN_Company_Search` |
| `/Pages/Poll/DoPoll.aspx` | same as above | Alternate path |
| `/Pages/Poll/PlanList.aspx` | — | Admin plan list |
| `/Pages/Poll/PlanDetail.aspx` | `id` (encoded PlanID) | Edit plan; no `id` = new |
| Menu link | `MainMenu.ascx` → `/Pages/Poll/PlanList.aspx` | Requires `POL_Plan_View` permission |

**Navigation examples from code:**
- Popup after login → `/khaosat.aspx?pid={encoded PlanID}`
- Plan list "Do poll" link → `/khaosat.aspx?pid={encoded PlanID}`
- Plan list "Edit" → `/Pages/Poll/PlanDetail.aspx?id={encoded PlanID}`
- Add new plan → `/Pages/Poll/PlanDetail.aspx`

## Summary

- **Web app** is in `g:\1.1-PROJECT-MAIN\khảo sát - nsg\hos\`; poll logic is UI-only.
- **BLL** lives in external `PollObject.dll` (not in repo).
- **Do-poll flow:** `CheckAllowDoPoll` → `Get` plan → `SearchForDo` (parts/questions/answers) → `POL_Done.Add` → `POL_DoneDetail.Add` per answer.
- **Admin flow:** `PlanList` → `PlanDetail` → `Edit` + `Plan_Course` with standard CRUD SPs.
- **Primary poll URL:** `/khaosat.aspx?pid=...` (alias of `DoPoll.aspx`).
